summary: Even for fixed A=I_3, iid strictly positive analytic-Schwartz cap-one inputs, uniformly tight outputs and ||p||_infinity<=2pi, there are tau_m->infinity with |p_hat_m(tau_m)|>=27/512. Therefore for h_m=pi/tau_m, ||T_{h_m}p_m-p_m||_1>=27/256; TV(p_m)>=(27/512)tau_m; every positive B^alpha_{1,infinity} translation seminorm diverges; and Gaussian desmoothing at epsilon_m=1/tau_m has L1 error at least (1-e^{-1/2})27/512. Thus no target-uniform raw-output L1 translation modulus, BV/positive Besov bound, or uniform approximate-identity desmoothing rate exists. This is not a QFORM counterexample. The exact fixed-scale heat-height normal form remains valid because it uses spectral homogeneity, not uniform desmoothing.
